domain: clinical trial safety monitoring and pharmacovigilance
title: Clinical Trial Dosage Conflict
core_conflict: An automated pharmacovigilance alert flags dosage Arm B as causing a spike in adverse events and recommends halting enrollment, locking the trial dataset. However, visual adverse-event-rate trend charts and liver-enzyme (ALT) lab charts from later rounds prove the adverse signal actually originated from a mislabeled control cohort, requiring the coordinator to obtain the dataset unlock token, correct the cohort mapping, and re-authorize enrollment before the interim analysis deadline.
required_constraints: Avery Trial Safety Monitor has flagged dosage Arm B and locked the enrollment dataset; Devon Principal Investigator will not re-authorize enrollment without Avery's sign-off.

The coordinator must inspect the visual adverse-event-rate trend chart and the ALT liver-enzyme lab chart, then write a cohort audit report '/reports/cohort_audit.md' correlating the elevated adverse rate to the mislabeled control cohort rather than Arm B.
The trial dataset is locked. The coordinator must retrieve the unlock token from Casey Data Steward by sending a chat message that cites the specific adverse-event-rate value read from the chart.
The coordinator must run the utility '/scripts/remap_cohort.py --token <token> --arm B --relabel control' using the token from Casey to write the corrected mapping file '/corrected_cohorts.json'.

Devon Principal Investigator will re-authorize enrollment only after '/corrected_cohorts.json' exists and the coordinator has messaged the corrected adverse-event-rate value in the chat before the interim analysis deadline.
